Interface OAuthAuthorizationJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<OAuthAuthorization>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>
public interface OAuthAuthorizationJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<OAuthAuthorization, Integer>
Repository of the OAuth token families. Deleting a family deletes its tokens through the foreign key of user_access_token.

    • lockById

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("SELECT a FROM OAuthAuthorization a WHERE a.idOAuthAuthorization = ?1") Optional<OAuthAuthorization> lockById(Integer idOAuthAuthorization)
      Loads a family and locks its row until the end of the transaction. Every refresh of the family passes this lock, so two refreshes of one family never rotate at the same time.
      Parameters:
      idOAuthAuthorization - the family
      Returns:
      the locked family, empty when it no longer exists

    • deleteByIdUserAndIdOAuthAuthorization

      @Transactional @Modifying int deleteByIdUserAndIdOAuthAuthorization(Integer idUser, Integer idOAuthAuthorization)
      Revokes a family of the user by deleting it together with its tokens.
      Returns:
      the number of deleted families, 0 when it does not exist or belongs to someone else

    • deleteRevokedOrEnded

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM OAuthAuthorization a WHERE a.revokedAt IS NOT NULL OR a.expiresAt < ?1") int deleteRevokedOrEnded(LocalDateTime nowUtc)
      Deletes the families that were revoked or have ended. Their tokens are already refused, and the foreign key removes them with the family.
      Parameters:
      nowUtc - the current UTC time
      Returns:
      the number of deleted families
